name: Saimin Ippon: hypnoticthrow
source:
Hayato Takeda, the captain of the judo club at Kitayama University, gets involved in a strange experiment conducted by a psychology professor over the summer to solve the problem of insufficient attendance days required for graduation credits.

[From [url=https://kujiranosenaka.itch.io/saimin-ippon-hypnoticthrow-part-1]Itch.io[/url]]
